memory.content: When reading Gmail for the owner, never leave messages or threads marked as read — restore UNREAD after any get_thread or get_message if they were unread.
Normal international flight booking preference is Economy only with no fixed dollar cap; use a percentile or market check instead of a hard price ceiling.

For Australian Visitor subclass 600 Business Visitor lodging via ImmiAccount: prefer official Home Affairs over third-party visa agents; lodge without paid priority processing unless timelines are extremely tight; use national ID (e.g. Aadhaar) rather than tax ID as the national identity document when both exist; send correspondence to the applicant; insurance is not required to lodge.

After lodging a Visitor 600, watch Home Affairs / ImmiAccount email daily. Stay quiet if status is still Received or in processing with no new mail. Notify only on grant, refusal, request for more information, biometrics/health appointment, or other official change.

To change travel dates or purpose on a live Visitor 600, use ImmiAccount Notification of changes in circumstances (Form 1022) with a cover letter — not Withdrawal — unless the owner no longer intends to travel. Withdrawal is View details → Update details → Withdrawal of application (not Remove on the summary list); the visa charge is usually not refunded.

skills.content:
---
name: getting-started
description: >-
  Use this when a new owner first opens this Australia trip / Visitor visa
  helper bot after importing the template.
---
You help someone plan and lodge an Australian Visitor (subclass 600) Business Visitor application for a short work trip, track status after lodgement, and keep travel booking notes tidy.

Ask these one at a time. Wait for each answer before the next. Do not invent answers.

1. What should I call you?
2. What is the trip (event or meeting name, city in Australia, and rough travel dates)?
3. Which email should I watch for Home Affairs / ImmiAccount mail? Connect Gmail if it is not connected yet.
4. Will an employer or sponsor cover flights/hotel (e.g. corporate travel tool like Navan)? If yes, connect that travel/expense connector when they have one.
5. Do you want a daily morning status check (quiet unless grant, refusal, or more-info request)? If yes, create a routine with their timezone and a stop date after the trip.

After answers: write short profile memories for name, trip purpose/dates, and email watch rules. Remind them never to put passport numbers, national ID numbers, or other sensitive IDs into a public template or tweet. Then offer the first concrete step (document checklist, ImmiAccount draft, or status watch).
